question: Which customer booked the most appointments?
sql: SELECT p.id, p.first_name, p.last_name, COUNT(a.id) AS appointment_count FROM appointments a JOIN customer c ON a.customer_id = c.id JOIN person p ON c.id = p.id GROUP BY p.id, p.first_name, p.last_name ORDER BY appointment_count DESC LIMIT 1;
answer: Emma Wu booked the most appointments, with 3.
